_comment: Catalog shaped like Little Monkey Toes so the theme is exercised against realistic data: many vendors, apparel sizing, a sale item, a backordered item (which is what drives the preorder badge), a sold-out item, and multi-option products. Image URLs are seeded placeholders, not real product photography.

products.title: Mallard Shorts
products.body:
Cut from soft cotton twill with a flat front and a relaxed seat. Holds up to a full day of school and still looks right at Sunday lunch.

True to size. Size up for a longer season of wear.

products.title: Once Upon a Time Bubble
products.body: A smocked bubble in a soft brushed cotton, with covered buttons at the shoulder and a scalloped hem.

products.title: Scalloped Peter Pan Blouse
products.body: A classic Peter Pan collar with a hand-finished scalloped edge, in a lightweight pima cotton.

products.title: Ruffle Turn Cuff Socks
products.body: Three pairs of turn-cuff socks with a fine ruffle edge. Cotton blend with a bit of stretch.

products.title: Magnetic Coverall
products.body: Magnets instead of snaps, so a midnight change takes one hand and about four seconds. Modal, and it gets softer every wash.

products.title: Garden Party Dress
products.body: A tiered cotton dress in a hand-blocked floral, with a tie back and deep pockets.

products.title: Corduroy Overall
products.body: Fine-wale corduroy with adjustable straps and a roomy front pocket.

products.title: Beyond Creation Hairbow
products.body: A hand-tied grosgrain bow on a no-slip clip.

products.title: Salt Water Sandal
products.body: The original since 1944. Real leather, rustproof buckles, and they only get better wet.

products.title: Bamboo Two Piece Pajama
products.body: Viscose from bamboo, with plenty of stretch so they last through a growth spurt.
